propositions: Cancelled ACLI link delete commands (exit non-zero with 'command cancelled' stderr due to stdin=DEVNULL with confirmation prompt) are counted as successful applied links, fabricating links_applied count while zero links are actually removed

The exception handler in _update_one_dispatch_links increments _links_applied for all CalledProcessError cases without distinguishing idempotent failures (404/409) from deterministic cancellations, with no diagnostic output hiding the miscounting from monitoring

The silent divergence persists across passes because the root cause is deterministic (EOF on stdin at confirmation prompt every time), not transient, yet the 'self-healing' comment assumes transient races

ACLI link create and link delete subcommands both accept --yes flag (verified in acli 1.3.19-stable help text) but neither call site passes it, mirroring the same bug 3256 mechanism already fixed for workitem delete
The batch_outcome reporting omits links_failed counter entirely, so cancelled deletes go undetected even when correctly not counted as applied, blocking the silent-noop canary from firing
